analysis.title: GS - Thompson - Nuclear Disconnect - 8 Oct 2026 (Marquee Overlay Issue 029)
key_insights: Nuclear investment continues to accelerate across utilities, infrastructure and technology, but positioning in uranium-related equities remains near the low end of recent ranges.
The disconnect between nuclear adoption and subdued positioning suggests the market may not be fully reflecting improving fundamentals.

Rising power requirements from AI and digital infrastructure continue to support themes tied to electricity generation, transmission and power equipment, reinforcing interest in long-duration energy solutions.
Preferred expressions from Equity Derivative Sales (Cullen Morgan, 7 Oct 2026) are the GS Uranium Basket (GSXURANI), a GSXURANI Nov26 107.5%/125% call spread, and a URA Nov26 45/50 call spread.

sector_views.rationale: Nuclear adoption is accelerating while positioning in uranium equities is near the low end of recent ranges, so the market may not be pricing improving fundamentals.
